purpose.domain_detail: A3ECO Spanish accounting/ERP system - bank parameterization module for clients/suppliers (cli/pro). Manages bank accounts (CCC - Código Cuenta Cliente), electronic banking configuration, and IBAN calculation.
purpose.summary: ECO9BAN is a bank parameterization module within the A3ECO Spanish accounting ERP system. It handles CRUD operations (alta/baja/modificar) for bank records associated with companies, including CCC account validation, electronic banking setup, IBAN calculation, and integration with various submodules (STABANCO, STABANEL, FEEEEVAR, ECOMCTA). It operates as a screenset-driven interactive program passing data via linkage section.
